questions.question: What was the name the demon-possessed man gave when Jesus asked?
What happened to the pigs after the unclean spirits entered them?
options: They scattered far across the distant hills
They rushed into the sea and drowned
questions.answer: They rushed into the sea and drowned

questions.question: Jairus was a ruler of the synagogue who asked Jesus to heal his daughter.
Daughter, your _____ has made you well. Go in peace, and be cured of your disease.
